sourceAnchors.visualArbitrationNote: Printed page 490 states that P=+0 has very great diagnostic value for Phobie. Under `Besondere Ichabwehr` it lists multiple Sch forms mixed within a Zehnerserie, but explicitly concludes that for Phobie the most important pathognostische signs are Integration im Ich Sch=±± and the phobische Reaktion im Affektleben P=+0. Canonical OCR preserves P=+0 but damages several Sch glyphs and omits part of the concluding prose, so the admitted PDF governs the pairing and hierarchy.

sourceExcerpt: Für die Phobie ist der diagnostische Wert der Reaktion P = -|- 0 sehr groß.
romanianRendering: În sindromatica specială a Phobie, Szondi spune că reacția P=+0 are o valoare diagnostică foarte mare. În aceeași pagină, după ce arată că într-o Zehnerserie pot apărea amestecate mai multe forme de Ich-Abwehr, el consideră Integration im Ich Sch=±± și P=+0 cele mai importante semne pathognostisch.
doctrinalStatement: Pagina 490 precizează ierarhia specifică a sindromului source-defined: deși într-o Zehnerserie pot apărea amestecate Integration, Arbeitszwang, Verdrängung, Zwangsprojektion, Entfremdung, Zwang și Desintegration, pentru `Phobie` Szondi acordă rangul cel mai mare cuplării `Integration im Ich Sch=±±` cu `P=+0` în Affektleben. Această precizare restrânge formularea mai generală Sch=±±/±+ din cadrul mecanismului de Integration: P=+0 + Sch=±± este perechea pe care sursa o declară cea mai importantă pathognostisch, dar nu trebuie transformată singură într-un diagnostic contemporan sau într-un trigger executabil fără review separat.
conditions: Requires the source's special Phobie syndrome context and a Zehnerserie when evaluating the mixture of Ich-defense forms.
Preserve the hierarchy between the broader Integration family and the source's most important Sch=±± plus P=+0 pairing.
exceptions: Do not infer Phobie from P=+0 alone.
Do not infer Phobie from Sch=±± alone.
Do not treat historical `pathognostisch` as modern diagnostic specificity or validation.
Do not reject the source-defined syndrome merely because other Sch defense forms also occur in the same ten-profile series.
scopeNotes: This record resolves a useful specific/generic balance: the broader paroxysmal + Integration structure remains valid, while the special syndrome chapter identifies a preferred two-vector core.
The many Triebklasse and Triebformel variants on pp. 489-490 remain source-atlas material.

relations.note: Specifies the special syndrome chapter's preferred Sch=±± + P=+0 core inside the broader paroxysmal + Integration family.

ambiguities: Canonical U005831-U005837 damages several Sch signs and does not preserve the full concluding prose; admitted PDF printed page 490 is authoritative for the Sch=±± + P=+0 hierarchy.
